title: God's Anger at Sin

questions.question: How has the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger?
options: He has cast down from heaven to earth the splendor of Israel
questions.correctAnswer: He has cast down from heaven to earth the splendor of Israel
questions.explanation: Lamentations 2:1 (ESV): "How the Lord in his anger has set the daughter of Zion under a cloud! He has cast down from heaven to earth the splendor of Israel;"

questions.question: The Lord has swallowed up without mercy all the habitations of whom?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 2:2 (ESV): "The Lord has swallowed up without mercy all the habitations of Jacob;"

questions.question: He has bent his bow like an enemy, with his right hand set like a what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 2:4 (ESV): "He has bent his bow like an enemy, with his right hand set like a foe;"

questions.question: The Lord has become like an enemy; he has swallowed up whom?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 2:5 (ESV): "The Lord has become like an enemy; he has swallowed up Israel;"

questions.question: The law is no more, and her prophets find no vision from whom?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 2:9 (ESV): "the law is no more, and her prophets find no vision from the LORD."

questions.question: Who sit on the ground in silence?
options: The elders of the daughter of Zion
questions.correctAnswer: The elders of the daughter of Zion
questions.explanation: Lamentations 2:10 (ESV): "The elders of the daughter of Zion sit on the ground in silence;"

questions.question: My eyes are spent with weeping; my stomach churns; my bile is poured out beacuse of the destruction of whom?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 2:11 (ESV): "my bile is poured out to the ground because of the destruction of the daughter of my people,"

questions.question: What do the children say to their mothers as they faint in the streets?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 2:12 (ESV): "They cry to their mothers, 'Where is bread and wine?'"

questions.question: Your prophets have seen for you false and deceptive what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 2:14 (ESV): "Your prophets have seen for you false and deceptive visions;"

questions.question: All who pass along the way clap their hands at you; they hiss and wag their heads at whom?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 2:15 (ESV): "All who pass along the way clap their hands at you; they hiss and wag their heads at the daughter of Jerusalem:"

questions.question: Arise, cry out in the night, at the beginning of the night watches! Pour out your heart like water before the presence of whom?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 2:19 (ESV): "Pour out your heart like water before the presence of the Lord!"

questions.question: Should women eat the fruit of their womb, the children of their what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 2:20 (ESV): "Should women eat the fruit of their womb, the children of their tender care?"

questions.question: You summoned as if to a festival day my terrors on every what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 2:22 (ESV): "You summoned as if to a festival day my terrors on every side,"

questions.question: With what have the prophets not exposed your iniquity to restore your fortunes?
options: They have not exposed your iniquity
questions.correctAnswer: They have not exposed your iniquity
questions.explanation: Lamentations 2:14 (ESV): "they have not exposed your iniquity to restore your fortunes,"

questions.question: What has the Lord done that he purposed?
options: Carried out his word that he commanded long ago
questions.correctAnswer: Carried out his word that he commanded long ago
questions.explanation: Lamentations 2:17 (ESV): "The LORD has done what he purposed; he has carried out his word, which he commanded long ago;"

key_verse_text: The LORD has done what he purposed; he has carried out his word, which he commanded long ago; he has thrown down without pity; he has made the enemy rejoice over you and exalted the might of your foes.
